messages:
olivia: Heads-up — we're seeing a subtle perf regression in staging after the matmul_v3 ABI swap from the quant pack build. Matmul latency p95 up ~8% on long sequences. I'm proposing a short pin on the new kernel while we triage and prepare a release-note fragment. Can ops/eng confirm pin window and rollback criteria?

deploybot: preflight results for build quant-pack-2.7-matmul_v3: canary smoke ✅, binary-signature OK, infra-compat mismatch warnings: 2 nodes. Auto-pin TTL default=1h.

sam: sharing stack traces + perf snippet, might be kernel tiling fallback. small logs: ```2026-03-19T23:12:12Z runtime: matmul fallback path triggered for seq_len=2048
matmul_v3: kernel_launch=slow_path
CPU fallback count=3```

maria: can we not full-pin org-wide immediately? suggest staged pin: staging + night bucket + 5% canary in prod first, give 30m observation per stage. Also we should capture kv-cache hit rate — could be eviction churn.

ryan_ops: what change window are you thinking? we have maintenance window 02:00-05:00 UTC tonight. If we want immediate hold, we can apply a cluster-level pin with 2h TTL and then extend if required. Also need release-note blurb for infra/ENTs.

olivia: good call. proposal: 5% canary (eu-west) 30m -> 20% 30m -> 50% 30m. Pin TTL initial 2h, extend only with explicit ack. Rollback triggers: p99 token latency +120ms vs baseline OR error rate >0.5% absolute OR increase in model-output repro rate on eval set >3%. If any trigger fire, immediate rollforward to previous kernel.

sam: +1 to triggers. I'll run diff-based eval on latest prompt suite now and post delta table. If we see output-level regressions we should abort.

maria: please add a canary smoke job that runs the `small-context` and `long-context` prompt sets every 5m during the canary window. Add alerting to paging rule `runtime-matmul-p99` and `runtime-matmul-err` with 1m aggregation.

ryan_ops: will do alerts. Also need binary checksum in release notes to validate what went out: `sha256:3f7a9b2e...` — ops will record that.

olivia: release-note snippet draft: "matmul_v3 kernel: improved memory packing and lower steady-state CPU utilization. Canary rollout planned; monitoring in place. Known issue: small latency regressions for very long sequence workloads under certain tiling fallback paths; rollback available." Thoughts?

sam: tweak: call out quant pack version and affected sequences: add "affects long sequences (>=2048) when running quant-pack-2.7 builds".

maria: also add mitigation steps for customers: suggest setting `serve.kv_cache.size` +1 or pin to previous runtime via console.

deploybot: pin applied to cluster-night for build quant-pack-2.7-matmul_v3 by olivia. TTL=2h. Canary created: eu-west-1 at 5% traffic.

olivia: starting first 30m observation. tagging @oncall-runtime in case alerts trigger. :eyes:

sam: posting quick diff results — output delta for eval suite: 0.2% token-level divergence, semantic score delta within noise. Latency tables: p95 up 6%, p99 up 9% on long-context tests. No error-rate spike so far.

maria: looks tolerable for first window. keep monitoring. If p99 crosses +120ms from baseline we'll abort.

ryan_ops: reminder: if we extend pin beyond TTL, create a JIRA with change window and list of approvers (eng lead + ops lead).

olivia: noted. If canary looks OK after 2 stages we'll update release notes and schedule a full swap in the maintenance window. For now hold pin and let it expire if no further action.

sam: I'll keep running the extended eval + KV-hit telemetry. Posting follow-ups in this thread.

maria: thanks — adding the smoke job now, will link runbook in docs. :thumbsup:
